title: Asa's Alliance with Aram and the Prophet Hanani's Rebuke
description: King Asa seeks help from Ben-Hadad, king of Aram, against Baasha of Israel instead of trusting in the Lord. The seer Hanani rebukes him sharply, but Asa becomes angry and puts the prophet in prison. Later, Asa is afflicted with a disease in his feet, yet even then he does not seek the Lord, only the physicians, before he dies and is buried in the City of David.
